camel_example: aliyun sysom GET /api/v1/copilot/sessions --region cn-hangzhou --agentId sysagent --maxResults 50 --nextToken 50 --scheduledTaskId 42 --sessionType openapi --header "Content-Type=application/json" --version 2023-12-30 --force
description_en: Queries the sessions of the current user and supports filtering by session source or scheduled task
description_zh: 查询当前用户的会话列表，支持按会话来源或定时任务筛选
kebab_example: aliyun sysom list-copilot-sessions --agent-id sysagent --max-results 50 --next-token 50 --session-type openapi --scheduled-task-id 42 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCopilotSessions

parameters.help_en: The Agent ID. If this parameter is not specified, all Agent sessions of the current user are queried
parameters.help_zh: Agent ID。不传时查询当前用户的全部 Agent 会话
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries per page. Default value: 50. Valid values: 1 to 1000
parameters.help_zh: 每页最大记录数，默认 50，范围 1～1000
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next page. Do not specify this parameter for the first query
parameters.help_zh: 下一页查询凭证。首次查询不传
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The session source. If this parameter is not specified, sessions are not filtered by source
parameters.help_zh: 会话来源。不传时不按来源筛选
parameters.name: session_type

parameters.help_en: The scheduled task ID, which must be a positive integer. If this parameter is specified, sessionType must be omitted or set to cron
parameters.help_zh: 定时任务 ID，必须为正整数。指定后，sessionType 只能省略或为 cron
parameters.name: scheduled_task_id

code.description_en: The returned status code. Success indicates that the request is successful. Other values indicate that the request failed
code.description_zh: 返回状态码。Success 表示请求成功；其他值表示请求失败

maxResults.description_en: The page size used for the current request

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. Pass this value back as is in the next request. An empty value indicates that no more pages are available
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页标记。下一次请求时原样传回；为空表示没有下一页

activeTurn.description_en: The information about the execution that currently occupies the session
activeTurn.description_zh: 当前占用会话的执行信息

agentId.description_en: The Agent ID bound to the current execution round
agentId.description_zh: 本轮执行绑定的 Agent ID

createdAt.description_en: The time when the current execution round was created, in ISO 8601 format
createdAt.description_zh: 本轮执行创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

finishedAt.description_en: The time when the execution ended, in ISO 8601 format. This field is empty if the execution has not ended
finishedAt.description_zh: 执行结束时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式。尚未结束时为空

inputTokens.description_en: The cumulative number of input tokens in the current round, which is not the incremental usage of the current event
inputTokens.description_zh: 本轮累计输入 Token 数，不是当前事件的增量用量

outputTokens.description_en: The cumulative number of output tokens in the current round
outputTokens.description_zh: 本轮累计输出 Token 数

pendingInputId.description_en: The ID of the form that is currently waiting for the user to fill out. This field is used when user input is submitted. This field is empty when no form needs to be filled out
pendingInputId.description_zh: 当前等待用户填写的表单 ID。提交用户输入时使用；没有待填写表单时为空

status.description_en:
The execution status. Valid values:
running: The execution is in progress.
waiting_input: Waiting for user input.
cancelling: The execution is being canceled.
completed: The execution is completed.
failed: The execution failed.
cancelled: The execution is canceled.
outcome_unknown: The result is unknown, and the session may still be occupied. The execution should not be automatically rerun
status.description_zh: 执行状态。running：执行中；waiting_input：等待用户输入；cancelling：正在取消；completed：已完成；failed：失败；cancelled：已取消；outcome_unknown：结果未知，仍可能占用会话，不应自动重跑

turnId.description_en: The ID of the current execution round, which is used to submit user input, reconnect, or stop the execution
turnId.description_zh: 本轮执行 ID，用于提交用户输入、重新连接或停止执行

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the current execution round was last updated, in ISO 8601 format
updatedAt.description_zh: 本轮执行最近更新时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

activeTurnId.description_en: The ID of the execution that currently occupies the session. This field is empty when no active execution exists
activeTurnId.description_zh: 当前占用会话的执行 ID。无活动执行时为空

agentId.description_en: The Agent tag of the session. The current executor is subject to activeTurn.agentId
agentId.description_zh: 会话的 Agent 标记。当前执行者以 activeTurn.agentId 为准

createdAt.description_en: The time when the session was created, in ISO 8601 format
createdAt.description_zh: 会话创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

scheduledTask.description_en: The snapshot information when the scheduled task is triggered. This field is returned only for scheduled task sessions and is empty for sessions from other sources
scheduledTask.description_zh: 定时任务触发时的快照信息。仅定时任务会话返回，其他来源会话为空

runId.description_en: The ID of the current scheduled execution. Different runIds are used for multiple triggers of the same scheduled task
runId.description_zh: 本次调度执行 ID。同一定时任务的多次触发使用不同的 runId

scheduledAt.description_en: The scheduled trigger time, in ISO 8601 format with time zone. This field is empty when no record exists
scheduledAt.description_zh: 计划触发时间，采用携带时区的 ISO 8601 格式。无记录时为空

startedAt.description_en: The time when Copilot started processing the current schedule, in ISO 8601 format with time zone. This is not the time when the model outputs the first token
startedAt.description_zh: Copilot 开始处理本次调度的时间，采用携带时区的 ISO 8601 格式。不是模型首字输出时间

taskId.description_en: The ID of the associated scheduled task

taskName.description_en: The name of the scheduled task at the time of this trigger
taskName.description_zh: 本次触发时的定时任务名称

timezone.description_en: The scheduling time zone of the scheduled task

sessionId.description_en: The session ID. Use this value when you send questions, query history, and delete sessions later
sessionId.description_zh: 会话 ID。后续发送问题、查询历史和删除会话时使用此值

sessionType.description_en:
The source from which the session was created. Valid values:
openapi: API call.
cron: Scheduled task.
im_dingtalk: DingTalk.
im_feishu: Lark.
alert: Alert.
This value is determined by the server and is not changed by subsequent follow-up questions
sessionType.description_zh: 会话创建来源。openapi：主动调用；cron：定时任务；im_dingtalk：钉钉；im_feishu：飞书；alert：告警。由服务端确定，后续追问不改变来源

status.description_en:
The session status. Valid values:
active: Not archived.
archived: Archived.
This field does not indicate whether the execution has ended
status.description_zh: 会话状态。active：未归档；archived：已归档。该字段不表示执行是否结束

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the session was last updated, in ISO 8601 format
updatedAt.description_zh: 会话最近更新时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式

userId.description_en: The ID of the user to whom the session belongs. This value is determined by the server based on the caller identity and is not used as a parameter for the client to specify the identity
userId.description_zh: 会话所属的用户 ID。该值由服务端根据调用身份确定，不作为客户端指定身份的参数

maxResults.description_en: The page size used for the current request

message.description_en: The error message. If code is Success, this field is empty. Otherwise, this field contains the request error message
message.description_zh: 错误信息。如果 code 为 Success，则本字段为空；否则本字段包含请求错误信息

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used for end-to-end diagnostics
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，可用于全链路诊断
